# evroc_security_group (Resource)

Provides an evroc security group resource for network firewall rules.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the security group. Must be unique within the project.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project this resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider project.
- `region` (String) Region where the security group is created. Defaults to provider region.
- `rule` (Block Set) List of security group rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `user_labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels (key/value pairs) for organizing and selecting resources.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the security group was created (RFC3339 format).
- `fqid` (String) Fully qualified resource ID (FQID). Use this to reference this resource from other resources.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `sg_id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the security group.
- `system_labels` (Map of String) System-managed labels automatically set by evroc (read-only).

<a id="nestedblock--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule`

Required:

- `direction` (String) Direction of traffic: 'Ingress' or 'Egress'.
- `name` (String) Name of the rule.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol: 'TCP', 'UDP', 'ICMP', or 'All'.

Optional:

- `end_port` (Number) End port for port ranges. Only applicable when protocol is TCP or UDP.
- `port` (Number) Port number (0 for all ports). Only applicable when protocol is TCP or UDP.
- `remote_ip` (String) Remote IP address or CIDR block. Mutually exclusive with remote_security_group and remote_subnet.
- `remote_security_group` (String) Name or FQID of a remote security group to allow traffic to/from. Mutually exclusive with remote_ip and remote_subnet.
- `remote_subnet` (String) Name of a remote subnet to allow traffic to/from. Mutually exclusive with remote_ip and remote_security_group.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String)
- `delete` (String)
- `update` (String)
